mentions.note: 33-year-old Californian; six women's ultramarathon world records; led at 13.5 miles and 30 miles, Leadville 100 (1994); finished 36 minutes behind, beating her own women's course record by more than two hours

photos.c: Left to right: Traditional running gear in the Mexican hills; cutting out a tyre to make running sandals; the Leadville 100; Ann Trason, women's ultrarunning champion
ULTRA CHAMPION Ann Trason holds six world records. She is the epitome of the modern, scientific, sponsored athlete.
